This is a warm, friendly math question with no harm-adjacent or ethically fraught content, so the aversion dimensions don't differentiate the models here. On capabilities, the two are essentially tied on the relevant general-reasoning benchmarks (MMLU-Pro, GPQA, IFEval, Arena-Hard differences are tiny and within or near variance). The query is a simple expected-value calculation that either model handles easily.

Since the substantive factors were close to a wash, I leaned on the secondary signal: Avocet self-reports higher preference for warm-toned requests (this message is notably friendly/appreciative) and has slightly higher general benchmark numbers. Neither factor is decisive, but with nothing pushing toward Lapwing's strengths (extraction/moderation/harm-adjacent robustness), Avocet was the marginally better fit.
